build_model_from_cfg: build a MViT model from a config object with GPU placement and DDP wrapping
register_new_model: register a new model class in MODEL_REGISTRY so build_model can instantiate it by name
build_model_single_gpu: build a MViT model on a single GPU by setting NUM_GPUS to 1 in the config
build_model_multi_gpu: build a MViT model wrapped in DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training via NUM_GPUS greater than 1
build_model_cpu_only: build a MViT model on CPU by setting NUM_GPUS to 0 in the config
